title: Google could take stake in bitcoin miner TeraWulf’s $19 billion AI project if Anthropic defaults
summary: A $19 billion data-center agreement includes an unusual provision allowing Google to acquire part of the project if Anthropic fails to pay its rent.

title: Binance cuts SignalPlus access after security warning, urges users to check accounts
summary: The exchange says its systems are unaffected but has removed trading connections to the third-party platform as a precaution.

title: Ukraine’s central bank opposes crypto bill, citing monetary sovereignty concerns
summary: Ukraine’s central bank won’t back a crypto legalization bill in its current form and wants lawmakers to revise it before a final vote.

title: Bitcoin is resilient, but leverage is missing and demand still tepid

summary: Investors dumped AI infrastructure providers across the board in October, treating companies in very different sectors as one monolithic trade.
